title: Clock-ready configuration
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration of the clock machine on input $x$, and let $m$ be a natural number. The configuration $c$ is clock-ready exactly when there exist a configuration $a$ of $A$ on input $x$, work-tape contents $s_T$ and work-head positions $s_P$ for the yardstick machine, such that $a$ is ready and $c$ is the clock-machine configuration obtained from $a$ at clock value $0$ with those yardstick tapes and head positions.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration $c$ of the clock machine on input $x$
caveat: The payload does not define the clock-configuration construction or its tape parameters, so their exact mathematical meaning cannot be made self-contained from the supplied definitions.
